relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression of FABP4 was upregulated in IL-1β-induced ATDC5 cells compared with that of control ATDC5 cells.

relationships.subject: FABP4
relationships.evidence_quote: knockdown of FABP4 suppressed the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines (Fig. 1F and G) and PGE2 in IL-1β-induced ATDC5 (Fig. 1H)

relationships.subject: FABP4
relationships.evidence_quote: Knockdown of FABP4 significantly downregulated p-NF-κB p65 expression and upregulated the expression of PPARγ

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: it was observed that IL-1β could significantly elevate the levels of the pro-inflammatory cytokines, TNF-α and IL-6

key_findings: FABP4 is upregulated by IL-1β in ATDC5 chondrocytes; its knockdown reduces inflammation, ROS, apoptosis and MMP expression.
FABP4 knockdown acts by raising PPARγ and lowering NF-κB p65 signaling.
